args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

Fixes unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

## Details
- Advisory: fastjson < 2.9.4 (also >=3.0.0 <3.1.0) is affected; fixed in 2.9.4 (and 3.1.0).
- The pin in `requirements.txt` was upgraded to the fixed release in the same major version (2.9.4), a minimal, low-risk change.
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: passed.
args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
